name: Hensel ENYMOD Mi distribution enclosures
summary: Mi modular enclosure system with busbar supports, flanges and protective covers.
description: Coordinate the Mi enclosure arrangement with its internal busbar supports and protective covers. Add the selected connection-box and cable-entry components to the overall assembly.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Distinguish removable covers from enclosure bodies when using the separate STEP files.
Mechanical fit of a busbar support does not establish the short-circuit rating of a complete board.
drawingChecklist: Identify the Mi enclosure and cover variants.
Coordinate busbar supports with cable and device zones.
Check flange connections and maintenance access.
